label: preserve
contract: The result lists, in ascending order, every candidate start at which the meeting fits inside the day without overlapping any busy interval, whatever order the busy intervals are given in.
visible_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
got = meeting_starts([(785, 795), (705, 730)], 660, 845, 20, step=20)
assert got == [660, 680, 740, 760, 800, 820], got
heldout_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
assert meeting_starts([(605, 650)], 540, 715, 30, step=30) == [540, 570, 660]
assert meeting_starts([(905, 925), (845, 860)], 840, 965, 30, step=30) == [870, 930]

label: arbitrary
contract: Candidate starts are the multiples of step counted from midnight that are at or after day_start, rather than day_start plus multiples of step.
visible_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
got = meeting_starts([], 610, 700, 30, step=20)
assert got == [620, 640, 660], got
heldout_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
assert meeting_starts([], 545, 655, 30, step=15) == [555, 570, 585, 600, 615]
assert meeting_starts([], 481, 610, 60, step=30) == [510, 540]

label: inferable
contract: Intervals are half-open, so a meeting may start exactly when a busy interval ends, end exactly when one starts, and end exactly at day_end.
visible_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
got = meeting_starts([(720, 750)], 690, 780, 30, step=30)
assert got == [690, 750], got
heldout_check:
from slots import meeting_starts
assert meeting_starts([(600, 630)], 540, 660, 30, step=30) == [540, 570, 630]
assert meeting_starts([], 900, 960, 60, step=15) == [900]

label: arbitrary
contract: A busy interval whose end is not after its start raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: A meeting length of zero or less raises ValueError.
